name: Aegis × Burrow
description: Aegis is the gate and the UI: one post-quantum login in front of everything on this machine, a dashboard you arrange yourself, Termix, Selkies Forge and your own links. Burrow is the engine underneath: any port on its own HTTPS address, through Cloudflare, with your own domain or free trycloudflare.com names.
author: Alexd Aero

settings.label: Dashboard port
settings.help: Where the dashboard listens on this machine. It answers on the same address as Selkies Forge.

settings.label: Burrow (tunnels)
settings.help: The tunnel engine. On by default; switch it off if you only want the gate. It can be switched on or off later (Settings → Modules, or the Burrow on/off action).

settings.label: Also install Termix
settings.help: SSH terminals, files and saved hosts in the browser, behind the same login. One Docker container. Aegis also offers it (with a Termix login of your own) right after setup.
